title: Show HN: Run an 80B Qwen in 4.3 GB of RAM on a Mac, and a 35B on an iPhone
summary: Swiftlet is an open-source project enabling large language models (up to 80B parameters) to run on consumer hardware with minimal memory requirements—4.3 GB RAM for an 80B Qwen model on Mac and a 35B model on iPhone—through advanced quantization and optimization techniques.
problem_solved: Makes running massive 80B+ parameter language models feasible on consumer devices with limited RAM, democratizing access to large AI models on edge devices like iPhones and personal Macs.
why_valuable: Breaks the memory barrier that previously required expensive cloud computing or high-end hardware, enabling private, offline AI inference on everyday devices.
